notes.title: 7.29.2019 - Build Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

The developers have just implemented a new build that addresses the issues below:

 Fix for start up crash some users are experiencing
 Fix for compatibility with antivirus softwares
 Fix for ALT+tab key changing the display mode issue
 Fix for LB/RB keys swapping in menus


We appreciate your patience and support!

Please report to our PC Support team using the form below if you continue to experience these issues or have anything else you need to report!

http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php
